meta.title: Sustainability Student Committees
meta.description: PEACE and SIGMA, the student committees taking XLRI’s sustainability and social outreach work forward, and their student representatives.

committees.name: PEACE
body: PEACE was created to leverage the students’ potential to foster a sustainability driven social transformation.

Working with FACES, an MOU is signed with the alumni batch of 1985-87 to have an annual national debate, “Fr. McGrath Memorial Debate on Responsible Leadership for the Greater Good”. The 4th edition was held in March 2024.

committees.name: SIGMA OKIOS
body: SIGMA undertakes periodic activities to help both the rural and urban poor.
Several activities like providing computers to rural schools, raising funds for several NGOs, and volunteering work to teach in schools are regular activities.
